title: Ban on Flavoured Tobacco to Curb Appeal to Youths
what_it_is: Ban on Flavoured Tobacco to Curb Appeal to Youths

sections.label: Flavoured tobacco ban and tax
sections.summary: The Ministry does not rule out a future ban on flavoured tobacco products and further tobacco tax increases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (a) whether the Ministry will consider a total ban on flavoured tobacco to curb youth appeal; and (b) whether further tobacco tax increases is being considered to discourage smoking.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We do not rule out introducing a ban on flavoured tobacco products in the future and implementing further tobacco tax increases.

sections.label: Flavoured cigarettes market share
sections.summary: In 2022, The Straits Times reported over 50% of cigarettes sold in Singapore are flavoured, far more than other countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: In 2022, The Straits Times reported over 50% of cigarettes sold in Singapore are flavoured.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: This was noted to be far more than in other countries where the market share is typically 5% to 25%.

sections.label: Flavoured tobacco youth appeal review
sections.summary: International evidence shows flavoured tobacco increases youth smoking initiation, and the Ministry is reviewing a possible ban.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Yes, indeed, there is a large body of international evidence showing that flavoured tobacco products increase smoking initiation, particularly amongst youths.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Because, as the Member had mentioned earlier, the flavours, like menthol or fruit, are used to mask the harsh tobacco flavour and this actually increases its appeal to the youths.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: He also mentioned about The Straits Times report, it is still fairly accurate that menthol cigarettes take up almost half of Singapore's cigarette market.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, we are definitely not close to reviewing this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I mentioned in the earlier answer, we are reviewing as to whether or not we will introduce a ban on the flavoured tobacco products.
